propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names while DC reads from config, breaking tenants with non-standard workflow status names like 'Closed' or 'Complete'.
Issues with non-standard resolved status names are misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED due to hardcoded status check.
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] defaulting to ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'] with environment override REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES.
classify_probe_response must resolve the configured status set at runtime, falling back to module default when config is unset, empty, or malformed.
Custom resolved-status config must override the default completely (not merge), so a tenant with jira.resolved_statuses=['Closed','Complete'] does not recognize 'Done' as resolved.
Implementation requires parity with DC's settings.py guard: empty configured list must fall back to module default rather than binding an empty set.
